tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags yul gyi paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub la rten 'brel gyi sgo nas rtogs pa brjod pa lta ba'i 'dod 'jo dad pa'i snye ma bzhugs so// dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi ngo mtshar gyi rtogs pa brjod pa lta ba'i 'dod 'jo dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya ba/ dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o rjes su gzung du gsol/ rab dga'i sar zhugs dbu ma'i lam ston mkhan/ /klu mchog lto 'gro'i gdengs ka grib bsil mdzad/ /bshad sgrub bstan la srol 'byed dang por grags/ /'phags mchog klu sgrub snying pos bdag la srungs/ /bstan rtsa tha snyad don dam dge sbyong tshul/ /zag bcas zag med khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin/ /'dul 'dzin gtsang ma'i sgo 'byed klu sgrub zhabs/ /snying nas dran no thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ /chos phung brgyad khri'i rtsa ba bden bzhi'i gtam/ /dkar nag las 'bras slu med ston pa'i phrin/ /tshu rol mdzes pa'i snying la thur ma mkhan/ /klu sgrub gso rig dbang pos bdag cag skyongs/ /rgyas 'bring sdus gsum dngos bstan stong pa'i mda'/ /rten 'byung rigs pa'i mda' gtan las drangs bas/ /dngos smra lta ngan snying shun 'grel mkhas pa/ /klu sgrub gzhu ldan dpung gis bdag la srungs/ /bden lta'i nad sel stong nyid mtshan 'dzin sman/ /ma zhu'i dug 'joms lta ngan kun zlog pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i sman sbyong chos 'khor tha ma'i bka'/ /mdo don smra mkhas klu sgrub der phyag yin/ /nyan rang 'phags tshogs dbu ma'i rgyal srid la/ /bkod kyang ngan goms zhi bde gshol med ma'i/ /mngal du nyal rnams phyag gis slong mdzad pa'i/ /klu sgrub drang srong mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rten 'byung rig sngags grub pas nyan rang kun/ /'phags pa'i zhing sar mthong chos myang 'das kyi/ /sngon med lo tog bskrun mdzad klu sgrub zhabs/ /sgyu ma'i rdzu 'phrul gar mkhan khyod la bsngags/

/dman pa'i 'phags rnams yang srid 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /rtag chad 'khri shing rigs pa'i mda' bo ches/ /sreg tshe srid pa'i rgyun thag phreng ba bcad/ /klu sgrub 'phongs rkyen dpa' bor bdag phyag 'tshal/ /srid bdun ris skye tshe gcig khams gzhan 'gro/ /nyan thos skye rgyud drangs nges ma phyed pa'i/ /mkhas rlom brgyal yang nges gsang bdud rtsi yis/ /'tsho mdzad klu sgrub sman pa'i rgyal por bstod/ /rnam shes skad cig bden dang ye shes tshe/ /rtag dang bden grub smra rnams rtag chad kyi/ /lta bar bsgrags tshe gzhan gzhung 'jig mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal srid der phyag yin/ /dngos smra grib ma'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i spor/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal ro langs 'brug gi sgra/ /'khun yang rang nyid 'joms pa'i ltas su log /klu sgrub ru mtshon ngom 'di phyag gi gnas/ /bdag lta'i 'tsho ba ma zhur stong nyid la/ /bden lta'i zug rngus sman nad sran gyi gzugs/ /gsor mi rung zhes rgyal dbang bka' rtags khrims/ /drang por srong mdzad klu sgrub snying nas bstod/ /thub pa'i grur zhugs rten 'byung bden grub kyis/ /rlung g.yor log skyod rtag chad rba klong cher/ /lhung rnams ma bzod lung rigs bya ma rta/ /brel mdzad klu sgrub mkhyen brtse'i phyag skyongs shig /gnyis bral ye shes rtag pa'am bden grub ces/ /rtag lta'i 'phyon ma snying zhugs mgron po la/ /snying gtam nyan rna nyul mkhas klu sgrub zhabs/ /blo bral mun par 'khyams pa'i skyabs mdzod cig /rnyog mar chu bzhin 'gro la gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes bsgrags las gzhan stong tshol rnams 'khrul/ /rten 'byung rigs pa'i sgro ldan tshogs gsum du/ /'phongs mkhas klu sgrub srid las rgyal gyur cig /bden grub dkar min thig le ma nyams par/ /mtha' bla lang tsho'i ngo 'dzum ngom yang khrel/ /mchu 'phyang zhar ma'i smin 'khyog lcags sgrog gis/

/'ching ba kun grol klu sgrub rgyal gyur cig /bden lta'i mthar 'dzin dgra la zon chug kyang / /mtshan 'dzin chom rkun dgra zin ma phyed par/ /rgyal ba'i lam der 'phags pa'i nor 'tshol la/ /ma nor lam ston klu sgrub der phyag 'tshal/ /dngos 'dzin dri ma bkru ba'i gdong ltar yang / /mtshan 'dzin sol bas phyug la bzhad gro nas/ /lta ba'i rim gnyis dza hu'i bu mo yis/ /dag byed cho ga klu sgrub der phyag 'tshal/ /bden 'dzin nad kyi rtsa ba ma phyung na/ /'phags par rlom yang nyon mongs dug ro yis/ /gnod ces theg gsum 'phags pa dbu ma yi/ /lta bar bkod mdzes klu sgrub der phyag 'tshal/ /theg gsum lta rim sgyu ma'i na chung la/ /khrel bzhin bden pa mngon rtogs gcig kho na'i/ /'chi med sgeg mo'i so phreng ngom mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub rgyal bas lung bstan rgyal gyur cig /chos kun chos nyid gsar mthong gcig kho na/ /bden mthong gnyis par 'phags pa'i gzigs pa bral/ /bden mthong bcu drug sgyu ma'i glang chen gyi/ /'khrul 'khor gzhig mkhas klu sgrub 'dir phyag yin/ /chos kun bden med ma rtogs dngos 'dzin snying / /rtag chad srin po'i khar chur bden mthong gi /lang tsho'i mtshar sdug rten 'byung gzigs 'dir med/ /klu sgrub rten 'brel mkhan khyod rgyal gyur cig /rten 'byung gnas las theg gsum 'phags kun gyi/ /bden lta'i ma rig rgyal po nyon mongs 'khor/ /srid pa'i rgyal srid dmangs su phab pa'i gtam/ /klu sgrub rgyal rnga brdung khyod sa 'dir rgyal/ /rtogs bya'i chos dang sgrub byed rgyas bsdus las/ /theg gnyis 'phags par rtogs tshul mi 'dra ba'i/ /ri bong cal smras ri dwags nags nas stongs/ /klu sgrub gdong lnga ldan khyod sa steng rgyal/ /dman 'phags rang don nyon mongs spong la 'dun/ /mtha' bral rdzogs par mi sgom gzhan dag gi /ri bong cal smra bil ba'i shing la dris/

/klu sgrub bstan pa'i srog shing rgyal gyur cig /dngos por bden 'dzin snying zhugs dngos smra bar/ /bsgrags pa'i dril chen thos tshe stobs ldan dpung / /sa 'og lag 'gro'i lto bar bcings par nges/ /bden gsung klu sgrub sa 'dir rgyal gyur cig /'phags kun mthong chos myang 'das shang kha'i sgra/ /thos tshe thub stong grangs med gsum gyi tshogs/ /gshol nas gsang chen myur lam bgrod do snyam/ /e ma klu sgrub tshur byon phyag gi gnas/ /bden cig drang don mig sgyu bden pa'i chur/ /'khrul pa'i mkhas rlom ri dwags mya ngam thang / /'khyam rnams ma bzod spros kun nyer zhi'i gnad/ /'doms mkhas klu sgrub 'dir byon 'gro 'di srungs/ /byang chub snying por bden gcig zla ba'i bu/ /chos dbyings sgra gcan kha skor thim pa'i mod/ /gnyis snang sems 'gags chos sku'i nyin byed shar/ /klu sgrub ston pa gnyis pa rgyal gyur cig /bden rdzun dgag sgrub phyogs gnyis spang blang bral/ /rnam par mi rtog don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /klu sgrub yid bzhin nor bu khyod gcig pur/ /snying nas gsol 'debs brtse bas gzung mdzod cig /khyod gsung rten 'byung zab mo rdo rje'i glu/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsis blug pas khyod kyi thugs/ /rab dga' mkhyen brtse'i byin rlabs snying la 'phos/ /khyod sku mdzes zhal ston cig klu sgrub zhabs/ /rtogs brjod dbyangs can sor gdub rgyud mangs sgras/ /dad rtsa 'khri shing spu long g.yo ba'i brdas/ /bos bzhin 'dren byed rdzing bur chu rlung 'bab/ /rab dgyes thugs rjes gzigs shig klu sgrub zhabs/ /nyan rang zhi bder 'khyud la thugs khrel na/ /nyam thag 'gro 'di bor nas padma can/ /dag zhing bde la sred mdzad khyod rigs sam/ /mgon med mgon du tshur byon klu sgrub zhabs/ /mtha' bral lta ba'i dbyings las mi g.yo yang / /skye 'gro'i sdug bsngal dran pa'i mel tshe brel/

/snying rjes dbang med mkhyen brtse'i lcags kyu yis/ /'khor ba'i 'dam nas drongs shig klu sgrub zhabs/ /bdag kyang tshe ring khyod kyi gsung rab la/ /thos bsam sgom pas sa lam mthar phyin nas/ /mtha' bral lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bo'i spor/ /zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsis grol bar mdzod/ /khyad par rten 'byung 'tshang rig yang srid du/ /skye ba'i lam chad mthong chos lus 'di yis/ /bde ldan zhing du 'phags mchog zhal mnga' der/ /padma'i sbugs su rdzas te skye bar mdzod/ /klu sgrub shing rta'i srol chen gur zhugs nas/ /ci 'dod nor bu'i lam rtsol mgron rnams la/ /zhing skyong ded dpon mchog gis lam phye ste/ /rgyal dang sems dpas bkra shis mnga' gsol mdzod/ /ces dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub la rten 'byung ngag gi sgo nas rtogs pa mdzod pa lta bu'i 'dod 'jo dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yul byang phyogs kyi rgyud du skyes pa rig pa'i gnas lnga la spobs pa dge zhing rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin pa shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lan gcig ma yin pa bskul ba las/ phyi shes bya'i gnas la blo gros kyi 'jug pa mi dman zhing dpal sa skya pa'i rgyud gsum man ngag 'dzin pa'i shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa mang du thos pa klu sgrub sde snod gyi rgya mtsho gang des/ lcags stag zla ba gnyis pa'i dmar cha dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ mdar grang chen chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla brang slob bshad bkra shis brtsegs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zab mo lta ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /dge zhing bkra shis/ 'di 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i lung a nandas thos// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ klu sgrub la rten 'brel gyi sgo nas rtogs pa brjod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
